system.description:
Skill: Nature

Exploit Type: Skilled Exploit

You attempt to emulate the sounds of the natural predator of a creature you can see within 60 feet, that you are hidden from. As an Action, make a nature check contested by the target’s Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the target is Demoralized or Shaken and on its turn, must take the Dash action and attempt to run away, using the safest available route on its turn, unless there is nowhere to move.
